children: Plutonian Acquisition Corp. II reported net income of $711573 for the three months ended Aug. 31, 2026, versus a net loss of $16366 in the year-ago quarter; diluted earnings per share were $0.05 compared with $(0.01) in the prior-year quarter. For the six months ended Aug. 31, 2026, net income was $933250 versus a loss of $61790 for the same period a year earlier.
Net income: $711.6K for the three months ended Aug. 31, 2026, versus a net loss of $(16.4K) in 3Q 2025.
Diluted EPS: $0.05 for the three months ended Aug. 31, 2026, versus $(0.01) in 3Q 2025.
Net income (six-month): $933.3K for the six months ended Aug. 31, 2026, versus $(61.8K) for the six months ended Aug. 31, 2025.
Plutonian Acquisition Corp. II operates as a blank-check (SPAC) formed to effect an initial business combination with target companies.
Proceeds from the IPO and private placements are held in trust to finance a business combination and provide post-closing working capital.
No operating revenues to date; activity has been limited to the IPO, searching for targets, conducting due diligence and preparing transactions.
The company entered a definitive Business Combination Agreement to acquire NT1, subject to approvals, valuation adjustments and customary closing conditions.
Management noted substantial doubt about sustaining operations beyond the mandatory liquidation date if a business combination is not completed.
